title: Design a File Sharing System
description: Manage user IDs and the files they own, supporting join, leave, request, and report operations.
pseudocode:
1. join(userID): add userID to availableUsers (min-heap)
2. leave(userID): remove userID from ownedFiles and add to availableUsers
3. request(userID, chunkID): find users who own chunkID, return sorted list
4. report(userID, chunkID): add chunkID to ownedFiles[userID]

steps.note: User 3 requests chunk 10, system identifies owners [1, 2]
